deliverables: A pull request to vericairn-example-app, merged after its checks pass on Linux, macOS and Windows
body.exitQuestion: Does tally print the lines, words and characters of files and of standard input, tested, with the README describing them?
body.intent: tally counts only lines; people comparing texts also want their words and characters.
scope: tally prints the lines, words and characters of each file and of standard input, in that order, separated by spaces, followed by the path for a file
A word is a run of characters that are not whitespace; a character is a Unicode scalar value
Tests for each count, including empty input, input without a final line break and text outside ASCII
body.title: Count words and characters as well as lines
